alloy.preparation: Mounted on end in low-viscosity epoxy (28°C curing), approximately 10⁻⁴ cm² cross-section exposed; wet-polished through 1200-grit SiC, finished with 1-µm alumina, then rinsed in deionized water.

test_solution.preparation: Deionized water and ACS-certified reagents; nitrogen-purged. pH adjusted using 1 M NaOH or 1 M HCl as necessary.

test_method.procedure_description: One hour at open circuit in 25°C nitrogen-purged solution, then scan beginning at −0.1 V relative to OCP; scan anodically and reverse at 1000 µA/cm². PAR 273A, platinum-mesh counter and SCE reference; 10–20 scans per composition for statistical summaries.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit from the anodic transition; when unclear, potential at a current density two orders of magnitude above ipass. Reverse scan threshold defines a separate Erp.

experiments.result_note: Source-reported mean ± printed uncertainty; statistical meaning of ± is not specified. Epit criterion is two orders of magnitude above ipass when the scan’s Epit is unclear; authors do not identify affected individual results.

alloy.microstructure: As-spun amorphous alloy; possible nanoscale heterogeneity discussed as a limitation of conventional XRD.

alloy.preparation: Ingots from >99.999% Al, >99.995% Co and >99.9% Ce; single-wheel melt spinning under helium at 52 m/s to ribbons approximately 20 µm thick and 2 mm wide. Exposed at 550°C for 24 h to induce complete recrystallization; unencapsulated, thermal oxide removed by polishing. Mounted on end in low-viscosity epoxy (28°C curing), approximately 10⁻⁴ cm² cross-section exposed; wet-polished through 1200-grit SiC, finished with 1-µm alumina, then rinsed in deionized water.

alloy.preparation: Ingots from >99.999% Al, >99.995% Co and >99.9% Ce; single-wheel melt spinning under helium at 52 m/s to ribbons approximately 20 µm thick and 2 mm wide. Artificially aged at 100°C for 1 h; thermal oxide removed by polishing. Mounted on end in low-viscosity epoxy (28°C curing), approximately 10⁻⁴ cm² cross-section exposed; wet-polished through 1200-grit SiC, finished with 1-µm alumina, then rinsed in deionized water.
alloy.microstructure: Initially amorphous; low-temperature treatment produces structural relaxation and/or partial devitrification with isolated nanocrystals. The paper reports aluminum nanocrystals after the 100-h treatment.

experiments.result_note: Average with graphical vertical endpoints; error-bar statistic is not explicitly defined. This is separate from the fully crystalline 550°C comparison. The 100°C coordinate is an aging temperature, while electrochemical testing is at 25°C. Figure 2 caption identifies Al87Co8.7Ce4.3 for its XRD series, whereas the aging-methods text identifies Al87Co7Ce6; no more specific phase fraction is inferred for the Figure 8 alloy.
